what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1973?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1973 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (128 pages) was searched for gross, wages, payroll and salary and found only the `Special Details Wages` lines (p55 payments, p59 schedule and the matching receipt on p49), payroll DEDUCTION totals paid out (p54, federal and state withholding) and the school personnel listing (p99-114), which names staff with education and start date and prints no pay (sources/data/report-tables/1973/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1973 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in 1973, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1973 report prints the revolving funds' balances as three lines of the balance sheet (p43 `Revolving Funds`: School Lunch 9,343.69, School Athletics 3,597.98, Adult Education 12.31) and as lines of the accountant's schedule with their forward, receipts and expended columns (p59), mixed in with special articles and grants; no schedule that separates the funds. Searched revolving and special revenue (p43, p59 only) (sources/data/report-tables/1973/). — closes: the Town Accountant's 1973 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1974?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and tax history from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1973 report prints real estate and personal property valuation and the tax-rate change in the Assessors' prose, and a three-line facts list (p3, not landed), and the Tax Collector's levy by year (p46, landed in `tax-collection`); no valuation by class table and no overlay or new growth schedule. Searched valuation, tax rate, recapitulation and overlay in the whole text: valuation appears in the Assessors' prose and the p3 facts list, overlay as balance-sheet lines (p43) (sources/data/report-tables/1973/). — closes: the Board of Assessors' tax rate recapitulation for the 1973 transition year (DOR form LA-5).

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in 1973?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1973 report prints no such schedule: capital items appear as special articles in the accountant's 18-month schedule (p58-60) and as the voted articles (p67), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project, capital outlay and capital expenditures (sources/data/report-tables/1973/). — closes: the Town Accountant's 1973 capital projects ledger.

what: Was the 18-month budget spent on pace: what did the town spend in the six months January-June 1974 against what was left?
why: The accountant's schedule (p57-60) prints the 18-month funds available, the amount expended through December 31, 1973 (twelve of the eighteen months) and the balance at January 1, 1974. The report goes to press before June 30, 1974, so the second period's spending is not in any edition's table; the 1974 edition may print the 18-month close. Searched the whole text for `18 month` and `eighteen`: p56-60, p66, p121 (sources/data/report-tables/1973/). — closes: the 1974 annual town report's statement of the 18-month fiscal year ended June 30, 1974.
